scenes.text: What happens when the shade itself is in danger?
Street trees cool a city. But heat, drought and missing care can kill them, just when their shade is needed.
Across one hundred and sixty-four cities, fifty-six per cent of urban tree and shrub species already face temperatures beyond their natural range, and seventy-six per cent could by 2050.
Plant trees that suit the heat to come, and budget for the watering that keeps them alive.
